verdict.rationale: Integrating third-party partner-built agent apps is a fair ecosystem question for a coding agent, but nothing in the evidence documents a plugin system, marketplace, or partner-app integration in Aider. The scripting API and `--message` flag are developer building blocks. The community items describe Aider being embedded in other tools (Dosu) or a user-built PyPI add-on, not a first-party mechanism for integrating partner apps.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
